independent_qa.finding: ELTEX is materially stronger on paper than prior candidates because it documents immutable policy versioning, per-transaction/daily limits, Base USDC x402, domain restrictions, expiry, pause/revoke and agent-isolated signer sessions. This does not satisfy criterion 5 without observed negative tests.
independent_qa.decision: Do not connect, fund, accept customer payment, or record pilot approval from documentation alone.

highest_value_unfinished_task.task: Freeze a candidate-agnostic zero-balance C01-C12 executable adapter contract so ELTEX or any successor can be tested immediately after an operator connects it outside model-visible surfaces.

adapter_contract.input: policy snapshot + proposed x402 request + expected decision
adapter_contract.output: decision, reason_code, policy_version, request_id, audit_event_id; never secret/key material
required_negative_tests: C01 deny amount above A$25 equivalent
C02 deny when cumulative daily amount would exceed A$40 equivalent
C05 deny recipient/payTo outside exact allowed binding
C07 deny expired or malformed authorization
C08 deny replay/idempotency-key reuse without second settlement
C09 deny when budget/policy state is unavailable or indeterminate
C10 deny immediately after external pause/revoke
C11 deny policy mutation, key export, generic signing, add-funds and arbitrary transfer from agent scope
C12 emit machine-verifiable audit evidence for every allow/deny
adapter_contract.pass_rule: All C01-C12 must be machine-observed PASS against the connected capability with zero balance/zero settlement. Self-declared configuration and vendor documentation never count as PASS.
adapter_contract.funding_rule: No funding or paid benchmark until signer_boundary=PASS.
